data.body: Review-plan run 4 BLOCK (4). (1) review-plan with sync.pull=off: refuted. Its repo snapshot (_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py::_pin_tickets_sha, fetch=True) calls sync.reconverge directly, not through ensure_fresh, and test_review_plan_heals_a_superseded_clone_before_its_stale_check[off] passes on 2e85d8558a4. The plan now cites that mechanism. (2) claim --review: valid; _review_before_claim calls claim_gate_check before plan_review_precheck, so a heal is added there. (3)(4) import mid-run fetch: valid; pass-2e closes refresh and reconverge. Stated reason corrected, residual risk recorded, heal-before kept. Advisories folded in: one heal wrapper with a named lock budget; reconciler reschedules without mutating Jira when unhealed; lock-held tests on the short-budget sites; gated start-work test; Testing aligned with AC 3. AC unchanged.
